**Finding: compliant** (rule IP — Ownership of deliverables and Customer Data)

The document's IP package sits at our **preferred** position, so no redline was proposed:

- **§14.1** — Customer owns Customer Data, Confidential Information, Customer-provided material and independently developed IP; Vendor gets only a limited processing right.
- **§14.2** — Customer owns each Deliverable, with an express Vendor assignment of worldwide right, title and interest, personnel assignments and further assurance.
- **§14.3 + §13.2** — Vendor retains only Vendor Technology, and any embedded Vendor Technology carries a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, modify and create derivative works for our business (plus a duty to identify material Vendor Technology pre-delivery).
- **§14.4** — No joint ownership absent a signed instrument; feedback rights retained.
- **§15.1** — Supports data ownership via no-sale, no-advertising, no-model-training restrictions.

Noted for the record but not flagged as deviations: the Deliverable assignment is conditioned on payment of Fees, and §14.1's processing right includes "improve the Services" (mitigated by §15.1's no-training restriction).
